title: BOLDcurator: offline curation of BOLD specimen records
description:
BOLDcurator is a desktop app for curating BOLD (Barcode of Life Data System) specimen records offline, against a local snapshot of the public BOLD data package: BAGS grading, specimen quality scoring and ranking, BIN review, gap analysis, phylogeny and annotation, with exports for curation workflows.

Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux, and a pip/uv install route, are described at https://bge-barcoding.github.io/BOLDcuratoR/. The BOLD snapshots it works on are published separately (see related identifiers).
